card: Optimizes background prevout prefetching in CoinsViewOverlay during block connection by avoiding repeated per-block allocations. It preserves hash set buckets and salt across blocks to filter intra-block spends, reuses worker task vector storage, omits the final transaction ID from the set, and caps submitted tasks at the number of inputs. The author reports a 1% validation speedup, though benchmark setup and reproduction details are omitted.
changed_since_previous: The PR was taken out of draft and updated with an author claim of a 1% validation speedup.
evidence: Author claims in the description: 'Besides the simplifications this also results in a 1% validation speedup.'
problem: CoinsViewOverlay::StartFetching repeatedly allocates and deallocates the earlier-txids hash set and worker task vector for every block, reseeds the hash salt each time, inserts the final transaction ID even though it cannot be spent within the same block, and dispatches worker threads that do no work when queued inputs are fewer than worker count.

risk.why: Flaws in state cleanup between blocks or concurrency in task submission could cause prefetch deadlocks, crashes, or data corruption during block validation.

summary: Optimizes background prevout prefetching in CoinsViewOverlay during block connection by eliminating repeated per-block memory allocations. It persists the intra-block transaction ID filter and worker task vector across blocks, omits the block's final transaction ID from the set, and caps scheduled worker threads at the number of queued inputs.
